title: Chip supplier reportedly agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42B
description:
Broadcom reportedly agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease computing capacity built with chips it develops with Google, deepening a loop where the chip supplier would also fund its customer.

In the headlines (TCR #239):
- Broadcom reportedly agrees to lend Anthropic up to $42B to lease computing capacity built with chips it develops with Google; 47% of its 2025 sales ran through Amazon and Google
- Anthropic's exploit tests find Z.ai's open GLM-5.3 performing near gated Mythos; safeguards bypassed up to 100%
- Amazon ships Strands Decider 2B, Cloudflare open-sources Clef, days after OpenAI's Decisions API
- HIDTA, a 1980s anti-drug grant program, funnels some local Flock and Axon license-plate reads into HIDTA-linked databases
- The FDA approves Edwards' AUTUS, the first pediatric heart valve that widens as a child grows
- California signs laws paying homes to pool batteries, EVs, and appliances to ease grid stress
